title: InvestmentThesisSchema
description: Institutional schema for public equity investment thesis dossiers, multi-horizon financial forecasts, valuation multiple narratives, market share dynamics, and decisive recommendations.

ticker.description: Primary stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, BRK-B).

company_name.description: Full legal corporate name of the company.

benchmark_entry_price.description: Public reference entry price per share in USD.

current_price.description: Most recent closing price per share in USD.

target_exit_price.description: Long-term intrinsic value price target per share in USD.

expected_holding_period.description: Target investment horizon (e.g. '13 Weeks', '1 to 2 Years', '3 to 5 Years').

rating.description: Decisive investment rating based on multi-horizon return projections and margin of safety.

target_strategy.description: Primary trading/income strategy (e.g. 'Quality Compounder with Covered Call Harvesting', 'Growth Acceleration', 'Cash-Secured Put Entry').

sec_cik.description: 10-digit Central Index Key for SEC EDGAR retrieval.

sec_filing_url.description: Direct URL to primary SEC EDGAR filing.

core_thesis.description: High-level executive summary of the investment thesis and return hurdle justification.

business_profile.description: Comprehensive description of the company's operating structure, core business segments, flagship products/services, and revenue monetization model.

tam_and_market_share.description: Total addressable market valuation, current market penetration, and projected 3-year market share dynamics.

tam_estimate_usd_b.description: Estimated total addressable market in billions of USD.

current_market_share_pct.description: Current market share percentage of TAM.

projected_market_share_3y_pct.description: Projected market share percentage after 3 years under competitive forces.

tam_cagr_pct.description: Underlying market annual growth rate percentage.

narrative.description: Detailed narrative explaining market size, competitor landscape, market share defense, and expansion into adjacent TAM segments.

competitive_moat_analysis.description: Detailed analysis of defensible economic moats, switching costs, network effects, scale advantages, IP, and gross margin / ROIC defense.

capital_needs_and_strategy.description: Comprehensive evaluation of capital allocation, dividends declared and paid, share buyback programs, equity/bond issuance, anticipated capital needs, and going concern / liquidity assessment.

capital_allocation_philosophy.description: Primary capital allocation posture and philosophy of management.

dividends.description: Historical and forward dividend distribution metrics.

annual_dividend_usd.description: Current annualized dividend per share in USD.

dividend_yield_pct.description: Indicated dividend yield as a percentage of current share price.

payout_ratio_pct.description: Estimated dividend payout ratio as a percentage of earnings or free cash flow.

dividend_growth_rate_pct.description: Historical or expected annual dividend growth rate percentage.

description.description: Qualitative summary of dividend policy, payment frequency, and sustainability.

share_buybacks.description: Open-market share repurchase programs and execution pace.

buyback_program_active.description: Whether an authorized open-market share repurchase program is currently active.

authorized_capacity_usd_b.description: Remaining authorized share repurchase capacity in billions of USD.

net_annual_share_change_pct.description: Expected annual percentage change in shares outstanding (negative for share count reduction/burn, positive for net dilution).

description.description: Summary of share repurchase pace, Board authorization, and EPS compounding impact.

share_and_debt_issuance.description: Equity dilution, secondary offerings, bond issuances, and balance sheet leverage.

recent_equity_issuance.description: Recent equity financing or dilution mechanism (e.g. 'NONE', 'MODEST_SBC', 'SECONDARY_OFFERING').

recent_debt_issuance.description: Recent bond or credit facility activity (e.g. 'INVESTMENT_GRADE_BONDS', 'CONVERTIBLE_NOTES', 'COMMERCIAL_PAPER', 'NONE').

total_debt_usd_b.description: Total balance sheet debt in billions of USD.

cash_and_equivalents_usd_b.description: Total cash, cash equivalents, and short-term marketable securities in billions of USD.

net_cash_or_debt_usd_b.description: Net cash (positive) or net debt (negative) position in billions of USD.

debt_to_cash_ratio.description: Total debt divided by cash reserves.

description.description: Evaluation of debt leverage, refinancing obligations, and equity issuance profile.

anticipated_capital_needs.description: Forward capital expenditure requirements, liquidity runway, and going concern status.

annual_capex_usd_b.description: Estimated annual capital expenditures in billions of USD.

liquidity_runway_months.description: Estimated operational cash runway in months at current burn/reinvestment rates.

going_concern_warning.description: Whether an explicit going concern warning or substantial doubt disclosure has been flagged in SEC filings or audit reports.

funding_strategy.description: How management expects to satisfy its capital requirements (e.g. internal operating cash flows, debt facilities, equity offerings).

going_concern_assessment.description: Detailed auditor and fundamental assessment of solvency, bankruptcy risk, and capital runway.

narrative.description: Comprehensive qualitative synthesis of capital needs, shareholder returns, issuance activity, and solvency assurance.

share_dilution_or_buyback.description: Legacy management approach to share count, active buyback programs, and capital requirements / dilution assessment.

management_philosophy.description: Classification of management capital allocation posture.

buyback_program_active.description: Whether an authorized open-market share repurchase program is currently active.

authorized_capacity_usd_b.description: Remaining authorized share repurchase authorization in billions of USD.

net_annual_share_change_pct.description: Expected annual percentage change in shares outstanding (negative for share count reductions, positive for net dilution).

narrative.description: Detailed narrative evaluating management track record, FCF conversion supporting buybacks, or necessity of issuing equity to meet capital needs.

stock_based_compensation.description: Stock-based compensation (SBC), equity grant dilution, lock-up periods, and supply overhang risk assessment.

sbc_annual_expense_usd_b.description: Estimated annual stock-based compensation expense run-rate in billions of USD.

sbc_pct_of_revenue.description: Stock-based compensation expense as a percentage of trailing twelve month revenue.

gross_annual_dilution_pct.description: Gross annual share issuance rate from equity awards prior to buybacks.

net_dilution_rate_pct.description: Net annual change in diluted shares outstanding accounting for buybacks.

buyback_offset_status.description: Classification of corporate repurchase capacity relative to annual equity compensation dilution.

lock_up_status.description: Status of IPO/merger lockup restrictions and trading window policies.

lock_up_details.description: Granular description of lock-up expiration timing, 10b5-1 executive disposition plans, and post-earnings trading windows.

vesting_schedule_structure.description: Standard equity incentive vesting architecture (e.g. 4-year graded vesting, 3-year performance PSUs).

downward_price_pressure_risk.description: Supply overhang risk rating evaluating whether impending unlocks, tax sell-to-cover, or heavy dilution depress market share price.

narrative.description: Comprehensive qualitative analysis of stock compensation, dilution effects, lock-up dynamics, and thesis impact.

revenue_drivers_narrative.description: Detailed narrative explaining WHY the projected 13-quarter revenue path will materialize (growth vectors, product roadmap, enterprise/consumer adoption, market share, TAM expansion, pricing power).

valuation_ps_multiple_narrative.description: Detailed narrative explaining WHY the Price-to-Sales (P/S) ratio and valuation multiples will trend as projected to explain future price action (margin expansion, operating leverage, multiple re-rating or mean reversion, terminal moat dynamics).

revenue_forecast_13q.description: Quarterly revenue projections for the current quarter (Q0) and each of the next 12 quarters (3 years).

quarter_index.description: Index from 0 (current quarter) to 12 (12 quarters out).

date.description: Calendar quarter ending date in ISO format.

projected_revenue_b.description: Projected quarterly revenue in billions of USD.

yoy_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year revenue growth rate percentage (e.g. 14.5 for +14.5%).

projected_shares_b.description: Projected diluted shares outstanding in billions.

projected_shares_m.description: Projected diluted shares outstanding in millions.

implied_stock_price.description: Projected implied stock price in USD.

primary_growth_driver.description: Key business segment or catalyst driving revenue in this quarter.

catalyst_dependency.description: Specific product or service catalyst milestone tied to this quarter.

market_share_assumption_pct.description: Implied market share percentage assumed for this quarter.

shares_outstanding_projections.description: Projected diluted shares outstanding at 13, 26, 39, 52, 104, and 156 weeks.

horizon_label.description: Human-readable horizon (e.g. '13 Weeks (1Q)', '26 Weeks (2Q)', '39 Weeks (3Q)', '52 Weeks (1Y)', '104 Weeks (2Y)', '156 Weeks (3Y)').

net_annual_dilution_or_burn_rate_pct.description: Net annual share count change percentage (negative for buyback reduction, positive for dilution).

rationale.description: Repurchase authorization pace, free cash flow deployment, or stock-based compensation offsetting assumptions.

price_target_ranges.description: Projected price trading ranges over 13, 52, 104, and 156 weeks.

horizon_label.description: Human-readable label (e.g. '13 Weeks (Near-Term)', '52 Weeks (1 Year)', '104 Weeks (2 Years)', '156 Weeks (3 Years)').

bear_price.description: Lower bound trading price in a downside/multiple-compression scenario.

base_price.description: Expected base-case target price based on fundamental cash flow and earnings compounding.

bull_price.description: Upper bound trading price in an upside/multiple-expansion scenario.

implied_ps_multiple.description: Base-case Price-to-Sales (P/S) multiple implied by the base price and forward revenue.

annualized_cagr_pct.description: Annualized compound return percentage from current price to base target price.

catalyst_timeline.description: Multi-quarter timeline of major anticipated product, service, and strategic catalysts.

target_window.description: Target calendar quarter or date window (e.g. '2026-Q4', '2027-Q2').

product_or_service_name.description: Specific product, service, platform feature, or commercial expansion.

expected_revenue_impact_b.description: Expected incremental revenue contribution in billions of USD.

revenue_quarter_inflection.description: Quarter index or label in 13Q forecast where top-line inflection starts.

expected_outcome.description: Expected business, operational, or commercial milestone outcome.

invalidation_criteria.description: Deterministic quantitative or structural exit triggers that invalidate the thesis.

data_provenance.description: Verification audit log conforming to context/schemas/data_provenance.json.

analyst_price_targets.description: Sell-side analyst reports and price targets.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of thesis generation or last update.
